name: com.doinglab.foodlens.sdk.ui.activity.camera.FoodLensCameraActivity
description: When a user adds a meal photo through DoingLab FoodLens, this Activity lets them take a new photo or choose one from the gallery and sends the image into the food logging flow.
disableEffect: Users cannot start this FoodLens photo flow, so photo recognition and the related meal entry can break.
